description: Mark ranges in a session's grid so the user can SEE them — a list of findings they can walk, or where you are working right now. Ephemeral, never a commit, and it asks NOTHING: nobody has to respond, and the user may clear it whenever they like. To ask a question instead, use `prompt`. THE ORDER OF `ranges` IS THE ORDER THE USER WALKS THEM — rank a findings list most important first rather than in scan order. A `finding` or `question` call ADDS a list the user reviews, which stays until they dismiss it. `working` is your cursor — ONE range, where you are about to write: it replaces your prior `working` mark and clears itself when the workbook next changes or you highlight anything else; the user never manages it. An empty `ranges` array clears the given intent only. Only sessions with a UI view can show anything; on a headless sandbox this reports that nothing was marked. Brings the first range into view but never moves the user's selection — the selection is theirs.

intent.description: Visual intent: 'finding' (look at this), 'question' (candidates the user should judge), 'working' (the one range I am about to change — transient).

ranges.description: The ranges to mark, in the order the user should review them, e.g. [{"range":"Sheet1!B47","label":"hardcoded value"},{"range":"Sheet1!D12","label":"sign flipped"}]. Empty array clears this intent's highlights.

label.description: Short label for THIS range — what the user reads on arriving at it.

session_id.description: Target session id, from `info` or `list_sessions`. Required.

name: highlight
